Class CommandLists

java.lang.Object
com.atomictempest.core.CommandLists
public final class CommandLists extends Object
Console commands an admin sets in a menu as a list (API_VERSION 28): one line per command with an X to take it out, and one "+ Add a command" dropdown with ready-made rewards (a crate key, coins, a message to everyone) that writes the command, or an empty line to type one. The page keeps the commands as it always did (a list, or one text with " ; "). 
// build(): the list's rows and its Add dropdown, in an empty Group #StartRows of your page
CommandLists.draw(cmd, events, "#StartRows", draft.startCommands(), 5, "Action", "Id", "@Text", "start");
// handleDataEvent(): "CmdAdd", "CmdEdit" and "CmdRemove" come with Id "start" or "start:2" and the text
List<String> now = CommandLists.change(draft.startCommands(), data.action, data.id, data.text, 5);
A pick ("CmdAdd") or an X ("CmdRemove") draws the list again; a typed line ("CmdEdit") does not, so the cursor stays.
